files.bakes.py:
"""Print the morning bake sheet for Hollyhock Bakehouse.

The counter tills export one sales file per month into sales/, one row per
product and day:

    sold_on,product,trays,loaves

The bake sheet is one line per product that sold, in alphabetical order,
followed by a grand total line:

    <product>,<trays>,<loaves>
    GRAND,<trays>,<loaves>
"""

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit("the bake sheet is not written yet")
